page_title: ROM 4-0 CAG | AS Roma v Cagliari 05/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+2' The match has just finished.
90' 2 additional min. will be played.
90' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
90' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) pounces on a bouncing ball on the edge of the box, but sends his volley high over the bar.

89' Rasmus Kristensen (AS Roma) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
87' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Edoardo Bove (AS Roma) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
85' Adam Obert (Cagliari) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
85' Adam Obert (Cagliari) picks up an injury.
83' Cagliari are ruled offside.
82' Rick Karsdorp (AS Roma) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
80' Rick Karsdorp (AS Roma) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
80' Antoine Makoumbou (Cagliari) makes a rough challenge and Matteo Marcenaro blows his whistle for a foul.
79' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.

78' Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the bottom right corner, but Simone Scuffet pulls off an exquisite save to deny him. AS Roma have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
76' The corner is swung in but Cagliari can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
75' That will be all from Nahitan Nandez who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Alessandro Di Pardo (Cagliari).
75' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Cagliari. The referee signals a corner kick to Cagliari.
74' Daniele De Rossi decides to make a substitution. Paulo Dybala will be replaced by Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma).
73' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Cagliari win a corner.
71' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) decides to have a go at goal from the long-range free kick, but the wall jumps as one and makes the block. Danger averted!
70' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
67' The referee allows time for a substitution. Yerry Mina will be replaced by Mateusz Wieteska (Cagliari).

67' Ambitious effort from Paulo Dybala (AS Roma). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well wide of the left post.
66' Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) receives a yellow card for infringement.
66' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
65' Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
64' Rasmus Kristensen (AS Roma) plays a through ball but overhits it.
63' Rasmus Kristensen (AS Roma) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
62' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alberto Dossena leaves the pitch and Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) comes on.
62' Claudio Ranieri prepares a substitution. Matteo Prati is replaced by Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari).
62' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Paulo Daniel Dentello Azzi as he is replaced by Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari).

60' Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. The referee points to the corner flag and AS Roma will take a corner.
59' 4 - 0 Gooal! Leandro Paredes takes over corner duties. Dean Huijsen (AS Roma) gets his head on the ball from the corner and puts it into the left side of the net. 4:0.
58' It's going to be a corner kick.
58' The resulting set piece from AS Roma is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. The linesman points to the corner flag, AS Roma are going to take it.
58' Daniele De Rossi is forced to make a change. Angelino is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Rasmus Kristensen (AS Roma).
57' Angelino (AS Roma) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

57' The ball is cleared after Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. AS Roma will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
55' Substitution. Edoardo Bove (AS Roma) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Lorenzo Pellegrini walks off.
55' Here is a change. Diego Llorente is going off and Daniele De Rossi gives the last tactical orders to Dean Huijsen (AS Roma).
55' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma) replaces Stephan El Shaarawy.
54' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) is caught off guard a bit when the ball lands at his feet, causing him to rush a first-time shot that is easily blocked by an opposition player.
51' 3 - 0 Goal! Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Simone Scuffet to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom right corner.
51' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
51' Referee Matteo Marcenaro is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to AS Roma!
51' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for AS Roma as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.
50' AS Roma are awarded a penalty! The players claim that Andrea Petagna (Cagliari) handled the ball inside the box and it seems they are right.
48' AS Roma take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' The Cagliari players are stunned as referee Matteo Marcenaro changes his mind after a VAR review. NO PENALTY! Play to continue.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' The referee isn't 100% sure if it's a penalty to Cagliari, he's going to review using VAR.

44' Matteo Marcenaro blows his whistle after Diego Llorente (AS Roma) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. It's a penalty! Cagliari have an opportunity to score from the penalty spot.
43' AS Roma are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
43' The AS Roma players can't believe it after the referee disallows the goal after the intervention of the VAR!
42' The AS Roma players joy may have been justified, because referee Matteo Marcenaro is going use VAR to determine whether it was offside.
42' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
40' Andrea Petagna (Cagliari) displays brilliant awareness in the penalty box and sends in a first-time shot. He didn't hit the ball properly and it goes well wide of the left post.
39' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) plays a through ball but overhits it.
37' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Angelino (AS Roma) takes it short.
33' Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
29' AS Roma are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
27' Antoine Makoumbou (Cagliari) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Matteo Marcenaro saw the whole situation.

23' 2 - 0 What a goal! Lorenzo Pellegrini plays it to Paulo Dybala (AS Roma), who finds himself unmarked inside the box and slots a first-time shot past Simone Scuffet into the right side of the goal. 2:0.
21' Rick Karsdorp (AS Roma) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
20' Matteo Marcenaro blows his whistle and it's Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.

19' Andrea Petagna (Cagliari) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Rui Patricio makes a comfortable save.

18' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a low shot from long range which went towards the middle of the goal, but Simone Scuffet was ready and made a save.
15' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) leans back and sends a volley well wide of the left post from inside the box.
14' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
12' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
11' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) plays a through ball but overhits it.
9' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) wastes a huge chance as he sends a first-time shot from the goal area straight onto the right post!
7' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Adam Obert (Cagliari), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
7' Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. Cagliari get a corner.
7' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
6' AS Roma keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.

3' Unbelievable miss! Alberto Dossena (Cagliari) gets himself into a great position from the corner, but sends his header well wide of the right post from in front of goal when it was easier to score.
3' Cagliari force a corner. They send men into the box.
2' 1 - 0 Goal! A rebound wrong foots everyone except Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma), and he slams the ball into the open net from close range. 1:0.
2' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) meets the corner with a powerful well-placed header that beats the keeper, but the close-range effort is superbly blocked on the goal line by a defender. Unlucky!
1' There's an opportunity for Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
1' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. It will be a corner kick for AS Roma.
1' The first half has started.
AS Roma will kick the game off.
Matteo Marcenaro got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
Show lineups
